|colspan="6" align="left"|'''Notes:'''<br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|elim|1}} Before heading to a new camp, Nekmao competed in an elimination challenge. Fabienne lost the challenge,<br />and was eliminated from the game.<br />
{{note|ambassador|2}} At the ambassador's meeting, Francis and Claude had to nominate on member of each tribe to compete in a<br />duel to stay in the game. Patricia and Teheiura were selected to compete in the duel.<br />
{{note|negate|3}} Because Freddy won immunity, Isabelle's black vote was negated.<br />
{{note|elim2|4}} Moussa was eliminated at the immunity challenge for coming in last.<br />
{{note|negate2|5}} Because Moussa was eliminated at the immunity challenge, Teheiura's black vote was negated.<br />
{{note|idol|6}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, however, no votes were cast against its user.<br />
{{note|final5|7}} At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Patrick and Coumba came in<br />last and were eliminated.<br />
{{refend}}
